instruction: Change the color mode of my image to LAB in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: GIMP does not natively support LAB color mode conversion. While GIMP supports RGB, Grayscale, and Indexed color modes, it lacks the ability to work directly in the LAB color space, which is a perceptually uniform color model used in professional color editing. This limitation makes the task infeasible in GIMP.
metadata.infeasible_reason: GIMP lacks native LAB color mode support
